lessons.title: 有没有健康观念，对你重不重要
lessons.titleEn: Immunity First: Why Health Management Starts With Mindset
key: 免疫在前，药物在后：很多人靠自身免疫扛过感染并产生抗体，健康管理要从养好免疫力开始。
观念先于知识：没有健康观念，知识变不成行动，营养素也会被当成药，有症状才吃。
大健康以个人健康管理能力为核心，离疾病和药物越来越远，离生活习惯越来越近。
keyEn: Immunity comes before medicine: many people fight off infection with their own immune system, so health management starts with building immunity.
Mindset before knowledge: without it, facts never become habits, and nutrients get treated like drugs, taken only when symptoms appear.
Big health means your own ability to manage health: further from disease and medication, closer to daily routines and habits.

dated.zh: 开头的2020至2021年新冠疫情背景已过时，免疫在前、观念先行的核心观点不受影响。
dated.en: The opening 2020 to 2021 COVID background is dated. The core point that immunity and mindset come first still stands.

lessons.title: 涵养自己的健康观念
lessons.titleEn: Building a Health Mindset in Yourself and Your Family
key: 卧床测试：躺着不许翻身并计时，想清楚半夜能叫谁帮你翻身，爱家人就先照顾好自己。
防患于未然：天天坚持吃B族的人群，心脑血管病和脑卒中发病率更低，关键在每天吃。
传播的是观念不是产品：讲清吃什么、为什么吃、怎么吃，而且自己先做到。
keyEn: The bed test: lie still without turning over and time it, then ask who you could wake at night to turn you.
Prevent, don't wait: people who take B vitamins every day have lower rates of heart disease and stroke. Consistency is the key.
Share the mindset, not products: what to eat, why, and how. And do it yourself first.

lessons.title: 睡眠债务引发的惨案
lessons.titleEn: How Sleep Debt Destroys a Body
key: 睡眠三指标：时长够不够、时间点合不合理、质量高不高，任何一项不达标都要解决。
熬夜会分泌饥饿激素造成假饥饿，又伤肝影响脂肪代谢，一路发展到高血压、血栓和心梗。
酸枣仁和GABA舒压助眠，但不是安眠药，钙和B族也帮助稳定睡眠；保单不等于健康。
keyEn: Three sleep measures: enough hours, a sensible bedtime, and good quality. If any one falls short, address it.
Late nights trigger hunger hormones and false hunger, strain the liver's fat metabolism, and can end in high blood pressure, clots and heart attack.
Sour jujube seed and GABA ease stress and support sleep without being sleeping pills. Calcium and B vitamins help too.

dated.zh: 开头引用的2020年底员工猝死新闻和90后保单统计是当时的事，睡眠债务的机制讲解不受影响。
dated.en: The late-2020 news story and insurance statistics are from that time. The explanation of how sleep debt harms the body still stands.

lessons.title: 什么是正确的健康观念
lessons.titleEn: What Health Means Now, and Why the Old Thinking Fails
key: 世卫组织定义的健康不只是不生病，还包括心理、人际关系和道德价值观。
疾病谱变了：过去主要是细菌感染，现在是不良生活方式引起的慢性非传染性疾病。
吃药后血糖正常只是药物控制，不等于病好了，要找到并改掉引起症状的原因。
keyEn: The WHO defines health as more than not being sick: it also covers mental health, relationships and moral values.
The disease picture has changed, from bacterial infections to chronic non-communicable diseases driven by lifestyle.
Normal blood sugar on medication is drug control, not a cure. Find and change what caused it.

lessons.title: 健康-我们不能承受的生命之轻（上）
lessons.titleEn: China's Health Data, and the Limits of Medicine
key: 慢病井喷：2018年高血压人群达2.4亿，每7秒就有一人得癌，而且越来越年轻化。
全球约三分之一病人属于药物不良反应，美国研究认为健康寿命只有10%取决于医疗。
学生营养差：80%早餐质量差，蛋白摄入只有标准的65%，维生素A只有15%。
keyEn: Chronic disease is exploding: 240 million Chinese had hypertension in 2018, someone got cancer every 7 seconds, and patients keep getting younger.
About a third of patients worldwide suffer drug side effects, and a US study credits medicine with only 10% of healthy lifespan.
Students eat poorly: 80% have low-quality breakfasts, getting 65% of the protein standard and 15% of vitamin A.

dated.zh: 课中引用的是2013至2018年的健康统计，具体数字已旧，靠自我健康管理弥补医疗不足的观点不受影响。
dated.en: The health statistics are from 2013 to 2018 and now out of date. The point that self-management must fill the gap left by medicine still stands.

lessons.title: 健康-你不能承受的生命之轻（下）
lessons.titleEn: Aging, Children, and Taking Back Responsibility
key: 中国只用18年就进入老龄化，法国用了115年，两个年轻人可能要照顾四到八位老人。
孩子坐不住可能是缺营养：神经髓鞘会“漏电”，早餐缺优质蛋白，10点半后就难专心。
医院消灭癌细胞不等于好了，免疫力不提升就会复发；保险只挂钩医院，不挂钩一日三餐。
keyEn: China aged in 18 years versus France's 115, so two young adults may end up caring for four to eight elders.
A child who can't sit still may lack nutrients: nerve insulation "leaks", and without quality protein at breakfast, focus fades by 10:30.
Killing cancer cells is not recovery; without stronger immunity it returns. Insurance pays for hospitals, not for daily meals.

dated.zh: 2020年的老龄化数据和明星病例是当时的情况，自己为健康和养老负责的观点不受影响。
dated.en: The 2020 aging figures and celebrity cases reflect that time. The point about taking responsibility for your own health and old age still stands.

lessons.title: 健康管理重在免疫
lessons.titleEn: What Health Management Really Means
key: 2017年起国家提出以家庭为单位做健康管理，健康从医院转向社区，再转向家庭。
健康管理学没有新知识，教的是做决策：何时用西医、中医、营养，何时调心理、改习惯。
健康管理重在免疫：流感和带状疱疹是病毒感染，没有药能消灭病毒，免疫力上来才会好。
keyEn: Since 2017, national policy has made the family the unit of health management, moving health from hospital to community to home.
Health management adds no new facts. It teaches decisions: when to use Western medicine, Chinese medicine, nutrition, psychology or habit change.
Immunity comes first: flu and shingles are viral, no drug kills the virus, and recovery comes when immunity rises.

lessons.title: 健康管理重在学习
lessons.titleEn: Who Is Responsible for Your Health
key: 先读《失传的营养学》《非药而愈》，再备《病理学》《中国居民膳食指南》等工具书按症状查。
分清压症状和保器官：孩子尿蛋白靠强的松压下去，肾却可能慢慢受损，保护肾是自己的事。
慢病从低危到发病要几年到几十年，中间用营养干预，有可能阻断、延缓甚至逆转。
keyEn: Start with The Lost Nutrition and Healing Without Drugs, and keep reference books like Pathology and the Chinese Dietary Guidelines for lookups.
Tell suppressing a symptom from protecting an organ: prednisone can clear a child's urine protein while slowly harming the kidneys.
Chronic disease takes years or decades to develop, and nutrition in that window can block, slow or even reverse it.

lessons.title: 让你越老越有价值的健康管理四步
lessons.titleEn: The Four Steps of Health Management
key: 健康管理目标是一学二改三减四降：学方法、改习惯、减用药和医疗费、降血脂血糖血压体脂。
没有药、手术或保健品能根治慢病，说某产品根治糖尿病就不专业，必须同时改生活方式。
责任心让人更健康：安慰病人别说“什么都别操心”，要说“我们都等着你、需要你”。
keyEn: The goal: one learn, two change, three reduce, four lower. Learn self-care, change habits, cut medication and bills, lower lipids, sugar, pressure, fat.
No drug, surgery or supplement cures chronic disease. Claiming a product cures diabetes is unprofessional; lifestyle change is required.
Feeling needed keeps people healthier: tell a patient "we're all waiting for you, we need you," not "don't worry about anything."

lessons.title: 超过100岁？这个可以有
lessons.titleEn: How Long Can We Live
key: 公共营养师资格证2016年底已取消，取而代之的是健康管理师，谨防打证书旗号的培训班。
中国人平均寿命从1998年的70岁升到2019年的76岁，大约每10年增加3岁。
按端粒复制次数推算，理论寿命可达120到150岁，先定能自理地活过100岁的小目标。
keyEn: China scrapped the public nutritionist certificate at the end of 2016 and replaced it with health manager, so beware courses selling it.
Average life expectancy in China rose from 70 in 1998 to 76 in 2019, about 3 years per decade.
Telomere math puts the theoretical lifespan at 120 to 150. Set a first goal: live past 100 and stay independent.

dated.zh: 关于营养师证书和健康管理师认证的说法是2021年的政策情况，寿命统计也停在2019年，活过100岁的观念不受影响。
dated.en: The certificate and accreditation details reflect 2021 policy and the lifespan figures stop at 2019. The longevity mindset still stands.

lessons.title: 影响你健康的不可控因素
lessons.titleEn: The Factors We Cannot Control
key: 世卫组织：环境7%、医疗8%、社会10%、遗传15%属不可控，生活方式占60%，由自己掌握。
遗传不等于基因病：慢病像子弹上膛，要靠不良生活方式扣扳机，有家族史更要改习惯。
面对手术要多问几位与你无关的医生；国外动脉堵90%以上才放支架，国内70%就放。
keyEn: Per the WHO, environment (7%), medical care (8%), society (10%) and genes (15%) are uncontrollable. Lifestyle, at 60%, is yours.
Heredity is not genetic disease: chronic illness is a loaded gun that lifestyle triggers, so a family history means changing habits more.
Before surgery, consult several doctors with no stake in your case. Abroad, stents go in at 90% blockage; in China, at 70%.

lessons.title: 健康可控因素之心态
lessons.titleEn: The First Controllable Factor: Your State of Mind
key: 心态占健康50%以上：说“养好身体”不说“养病”，也别天天盯着某个器官担心。
多做善事和付出的事，会产生快乐激素和满足感，对免疫系统有好处。
人要有目标、觉得自己有用，否则潜意识启动“自毁模式”，生长激素和免疫力下降，老得快。
keyEn: Mindset is over half of health: say "strengthening my body," not "nursing an illness," and stop fixating on one organ.
Doing good and giving to others releases happy hormones and satisfaction, which supports the immune system.
Keep goals and feel useful. Otherwise the subconscious starts "self-destruct mode": growth hormone and immunity drop and aging speeds up.

lessons.title: 你计算过自己的睡眠周期吗？
lessons.titleEn: Sleep, Repair, and the Sleep Cycle
key: 睡眠两大作用：深睡时生长激素分泌高，身体在修复；同时分解白天大脑产生的毒素。
褪黑素怕光：睡前半小时别看手机，关灯睡觉，长期开灯睡易致胰岛素抵抗和二型糖尿病。
一个睡眠周期约1.5小时，按周期倒推上床时间；午睡要么20分钟，要么睡满2小时。
keyEn: Sleep repairs the body, since growth hormone peaks in deep sleep, and it clears the toxins the brain produces during the day.
Light suppresses melatonin: no phone for 30 minutes before bed, and sleep in the dark. Sleeping with lights on risks type 2 diabetes.
A sleep cycle is about 90 minutes, so count back from wake-up time. Nap either 20 minutes or a full two hours.

lessons.title: 为什么运动不意味着健康？
lessons.titleEn: Exercise in the Right Amount
key: 运动按年龄选：30岁前可做竞技运动，30到50岁做增肌，50岁后多练太极、八段锦。
运动大量消耗营养素，营养不足时身体会从四肢调营养保脑心肺肝肾，越练越亏还易受伤。
健身减肥不能不吃蛋白和维生素；游泳后最好干蒸排寒气，40岁后练瑜伽动作别求标准。
keyEn: Match exercise to age: competitive sports before 30, strength training from 30 to 50, tai chi and baduanjin after 50.
Exercise burns nutrients. When short, the body pulls them from the limbs to protect vital organs, so training drains you and invites injury.
Never cut protein and vitamins to lose weight. Take a dry sauna after swimming, and after 40 don't force perfect yoga poses.

lessons.title: 补充营养素的观念是哪儿来的
lessons.titleEn: Why Every Health Factor Comes Back to Diet
key: 心理、环境等所有因素最终都表现为体内生化反应，靠物质支撑，比如坏情绪会消耗大量B族。
现在食物营养密度下降、食量变小，加上抗生素激素和养殖问题，单靠三餐很难吃够营养素。
伤口愈合、推拿后排毒都靠自身修复和营养素，所以健康生活方式要从合理膳食开始。
keyEn: Every factor, mental or environmental, ends up as biochemistry that runs on nutrients. Bad moods, for example, burn through B vitamins.
Food is less nutrient-dense, portions are smaller, and antibiotics, hormones and farming practices add strain, so meals alone rarely cover needs.
Healing a wound or clearing toxins after massage depends on your own repair and nutrients, so a healthy lifestyle starts with diet.

lessons.title: 营养素与隐性饥饿（上）
lessons.titleEn: Nutrition, Nutrients and Hidden Hunger
key: 营养是进食、消化、吸收、利用四个环节，消化差的人瘦小，吸收了用不掉的人越来越胖。
七大营养素：水、蛋白质、脂肪、碳水、维生素、矿物质、膳食纤维，40多种必须每天从外界摄取。
宏量营养素缺了会饿，维生素矿物质缺了不会饿却会出症状，这叫隐性饥饿，吃药治不了。
keyEn: Nutrition is four steps: eating, digesting, absorbing, using. Poor digesters stay thin; people who absorb but can't use nutrients gain weight.
Seven nutrient classes: water, protein, fat, carbohydrate, vitamins, minerals and fiber. Over 40 nutrients must come from food every day.
Missing macronutrients makes you hungry; missing vitamins and minerals doesn't, but causes symptoms. That is hidden hunger, and drugs can't fix it.

lessons.title: 营养素与隐性饥饿（下）
lessons.titleEn: Hungry Cells Need Food, Not Medicine
key: 学会分辨细胞饿的症状和真正的病：细胞饿只能回到餐桌解决，吃药只能控制症状。
别问医生“能不能吃保健品”，要问“能不能正常吃三餐”，能吃三餐就能吃营养补充食品。
纽崔莱片剂用崩解技术，进胃就变成粉，能喝粥就能消化，解决的是细胞的隐性饥饿。
keyEn: Learn to tell cell-hunger symptoms from real disease. Cell hunger is solved at the table; drugs only control symptoms.
Don't ask a doctor "can I take supplements?" Ask "can I eat normal meals?" If yes, nutritional supplements are fine too.
Nutrilite tablets break down into powder in the stomach, so anyone who can eat porridge can digest them.

lessons.title: 营养素的参考摄入量
lessons.titleEn: How Much to Take: Understanding Reference Intakes
key: 膳食宝塔只能防止严重营养缺乏，防不了高血压、糖尿病这类慢性病。
维生素C推荐量100毫克只是“不死量”，抽一根烟约消耗50毫克，一天10根至少要600毫克。
修复要吃到AI以上、不超过UL；缺乏症明显时先吃到UL，症状消失再降回AI。
keyEn: The food pagoda only prevents severe deficiency. It does not prevent chronic diseases like hypertension or diabetes.
The 100 mg vitamin C recommendation is only a survival dose. Each cigarette burns about 50 mg, so ten daily need 600 mg.
To repair, take above the AI but below the UL. With clear deficiency signs, go up to the UL, then drop back once symptoms clear.

dated.zh: 课中引用的是2013版膳食营养素参考摄入量，具体数值以最新版为准，四个量的用法不受影响。
dated.en: The lesson cites the 2013 edition of China's reference intakes, so check the current edition for exact figures. How to use the four values still stands.

lessons.title: 纽崔莱为什么是食品
lessons.titleEn: Nutrilite and the Three Generations of Functional Food
key: 功能性食品分三代，第三代除了人体和动物试验，还要查清功效成分、结构、量效关系和机理。
没做临床的保健品只能写成分的功能，纽崔莱做临床，所以能界定产品本身的功能。
纽崔莱只做营养素，是食品不是药，选它先看安全：1934年至今的历史、自有农场、奥运会供应。
keyEn: Functional foods have three generations. The third must also pin down active ingredients, structure, dose-response and mechanism, beyond human and animal trials.
Supplements without clinical trials can only claim their ingredients' effects. Nutrilite runs trials, so it can state the product's own effects.
Nutrilite makes only nutrients: food, not medicine. Safety comes first, with a history since 1934, its own farms, and supplying Olympic teams.

dated.zh: 课中的保健食品功能目录、专利数量和人物年龄是录课当时的数据，分辨三代功能性食品的方法不受影响。
dated.en: The health-food function list, patent count and people's ages are from the time of recording. How to tell the three generations apart still stands.

lessons.title: 蛋白质及其生理作用（上）
lessons.titleEn: Protein, the Foundation of Life
key: 蛋白质以氨基酸形式吸收，9种必需氨基酸要从食物来，比例合适的才叫完全蛋白。
蛋白质是唯一能修补组织的原料，0到1岁脑细胞数量定型，1岁时已达成人的90%以上。
免疫细胞7天更新一次，一周蛋白不够下周免疫力就下降；修复期每天至少3勺，按体重加。
keyEn: Protein is absorbed as amino acids. Nine essential ones must come from food, and the right ratio makes a complete protein.
Only protein can rebuild tissue. Brain cell numbers are set by age one, already over 90% of the adult count.
Immune cells renew every 7 days, so a week short of protein lowers immunity. For repair, take 3+ scoops daily, scaled to weight.

lessons.title: 蛋白质有话说（下）
lessons.titleEn: Protein: How Much, When, and What Deficiency Looks Like
key: 成人每天每公斤体重需1到1.2克蛋白，11岁以上孩子和成人一样要75克，早餐要占三分之一。
缺蛋白肠胃会松：贲门松烧心反酸，幽门松引起反流性胃炎，大肠松导致便秘、小腹隆起。
病毒感冒时医生说别吃高蛋白，指的是鱼肉虾会增加负担，这时选好吸收、无毒素的植物蛋白。
keyEn: Adults need 1 to 1.2 g of protein per kg daily. From age 11, children need 75 g, a third at breakfast.
Protein shortage loosens the gut: a slack upper valve means heartburn, a slack lower one reflux gastritis, a slack colon constipation and a pot belly.
When doctors say no high protein during a viral cold, they mean meat and fish. Choose clean, easily absorbed plant protein instead.

lessons.title: 不可缺的维生素B族
lessons.titleEn: Vitamins: Food for Hungry Cells, and the B Family
key: 水溶性的B族和C不在体内储存，要天天补；脂溶性的A、D、E、K会储存，一天吃一次即可。
夏天每天晒15分钟太阳，产生的维生素D够用一年，上午10点前晒最好。
B族三大功能是调节代谢、建造皮肤黏膜、营养神经，消化差偏瘦和越吃越胖都可能缺B。
keyEn: Water-soluble B vitamins and C aren't stored, so take them daily. Fat-soluble A, D, E and K are stored, so once a day is enough.
Fifteen minutes of summer sun a day makes enough vitamin D for a year. Before 10 a.m. is best.
B vitamins drive metabolism, build skin and mucosa, and nourish nerves. Both thin poor absorbers and easy weight gainers may lack them.

dated.zh: 开头提到的入冬疫情反复是2021年的背景，维生素的知识不受影响。
dated.en: The opening mention of a winter COVID resurgence is 2021 background. The vitamin content still stands.

lessons.title: 代谢通行证-维生素B1
lessons.titleEn: The B Vitamins and Vitamin B1
key: B12和叶酸管细胞分裂，缺了红细胞不能成熟会贫血；孕早期缺叶酸易致胎儿神经管畸形。
现代人普遍缺B：精米精面去掉了麸皮里的B族，而高糖高脂、熬夜和压力又加大消耗。
B1管糖代谢和大脑能量，缺了易怒焦躁、心悸手抖、手脚发麻；脚气病和真菌脚气是两回事。
keyEn: B12 and folate drive cell division. Without them red cells don't mature, causing anemia, and low folate in early pregnancy risks neural tube defects.
Almost everyone lacks B vitamins: refined grains lose them with the bran, while sugar, fat, late nights and stress use more up.
B1 fuels sugar metabolism and the brain. Shortage shows as irritability, palpitations, tremor and numbness. Beriberi is not athlete's foot.

lessons.title: B族中的带头大哥B2
lessons.titleEn: Vitamin B2 and the Signs of Deficiency
key: 看嘴唇判断缺B2：正常是粉嫩的，缺了变大红甚至发紫，干裂脱皮有竖纹，喝水抹唇膏都没用。
口角炎、口腔溃疡、地图舌、舌边齿痕、舌苔厚口气重，都是缺B2的信号。
眼睛怕光流泪、孩子老揉眼睛、鼻翼三角区长痘和脂溢性皮炎，也提示该补B族了。
keyEn: Check the lips for B2: healthy lips are pink. Deficient ones turn deep red or purple, crack, peel, and show lines water won't fix.
Cracked mouth corners, mouth ulcers, geographic tongue, tooth marks on the tongue, a thick coating and bad breath all signal low B2.
Light sensitivity, watery eyes, a child rubbing their eyes, acne around the nose and seborrheic dermatitis also say it's time for B vitamins.

lessons.title: 女性和儿童与维生素B2的缺乏
lessons.titleEn: Why Children Run Short of B Vitamins, and What B2 Does
key: 孩子动脑多、B族消耗大，婴儿湿疹、过敏性鼻炎、哮喘、荨麻疹这一串过敏都与缺B有关。
缺B2血管壁变薄：易得痔疮和血管瘤、偏头痛、青春期流鼻血，一紧张血压就升、压差超过40。
黏膜新细胞补不上就成溃疡：口腔、胃、肠溃疡和宫颈糜烂，都是B2加蛋白质不够。
keyEn: Busy young brains burn B vitamins. The lesson links infant eczema, allergic rhinitis, asthma and hives, one allergy chain, to low B.
Low B2 thins vessel walls: hemorrhoids, hemangiomas, migraines, teen nosebleeds, and blood pressure that spikes under stress with a gap over 40.
When new mucosal cells can't replace old ones, ulcers form in the mouth, stomach and gut, or as cervical erosion. Too little B2 and protein.

lessons.title: B2与癌症肿瘤预防
lessons.titleEn: Vitamin B2, Ulcers and Cancer Risk, and How Much to Take
key: 药能消炎，但溃疡面要靠蛋白质和B2修复，否则反复发炎长息肉，剪掉也会再长。
B2推荐量成年男性1.4毫克、女性1.2毫克，有缺乏症的成人可参考每天10到35毫克。
单靠食物补B2要每天吃1.5公斤油菜或0.8公斤黄豆，压力大、孕期和哺乳期需要量更高。
keyEn: Drugs clear inflammation, but ulcers heal only with protein and B2. Otherwise inflammation recurs and polyps grow back even after removal.
B2 RNI: 1.4 mg for men, 1.2 mg for women. Adults with deficiency signs can take 10 to 35 mg daily as a guide.
Getting B2 from food alone would take 1.5 kg of rapeseed greens or 0.8 kg of soybeans a day. Stress, pregnancy and nursing raise needs.

dated.zh: 课中关于HPV疫苗价数和适用年龄的说法是录课时的情况，补充B2修复黏膜的观点不受影响。
dated.en: The HPV vaccine details, such as valency and age limits, reflect the time of recording. The point about B2 repairing mucosa still stands.

lessons.title: 维生素B家族的烟酸叶酸泛酸
lessons.titleEn: The Rest of the B Family: Niacin, B5, B6, B12 and Folate
key: 缺烟酸先在手背、前臂、面部等暴露部位出现对称性皮疹，再发展为入睡难或凌晨两三点醒。
泛酸关系抗压和抗体生成，缺了易过敏、哮喘，打疫苗也可能不产生抗体。
孕吐、累极了却睡不着是缺B6；B6适宜量1.3毫克，上限50毫克，一片B族含1.2毫克。
keyEn: Niacin deficiency starts as a symmetrical rash on exposed skin, then trouble falling asleep or waking at 2 to 3 a.m.
Pantothenic acid underpins stress tolerance and antibodies; shortage brings allergies, asthma, even vaccines that fail to produce antibodies.
Pregnancy vomiting and "exhausted but can't sleep" signal low B6. Adequate intake is 1.3 mg, upper limit 50 mg; one tablet has 1.2 mg.

dated.zh: 课中给打新冠疫苗的人继续吃B族的例子属于2021年前后的背景，泛酸与抗体的核心讲法不变。
dated.en: The COVID vaccine anecdote reflects the 2021 context; the core point about B5 and antibody production still stands.

lessons.title: B族与胎儿神经发育神经炎心脑血管的关系
lessons.titleEn: The B Vitamins in Review: Teamwork and Homocysteine
key: B族是水溶性辅酶，随汗尿流失要天天补；B1、B2、烟酸、泛酸环环相扣，必须整组一起吃。
孕早期缺叶酸，胎儿神经管闭合不全，会导致无脑儿和脊柱裂。
B6、B12、叶酸负责清除同型半胱氨酸，它偏高会伤血管，增加冠心病和脑卒中风险。
keyEn: B vitamins are water-soluble coenzymes lost in sweat and urine; B1, B2, niacin and B5 work as a chain, so take the full complex daily.
Too little folic acid in early pregnancy leaves the neural tube open, causing anencephaly and spina bifida.
B6, B12 and folate clear homocysteine; high levels damage blood vessels and raise heart disease and stroke risk.

lessons.title: VC抗氧化之细胞饥饿
lessons.titleEn: Vitamin C: A Nutrient, Not a Medicine
key: 人体不能自己合成维生素C；坏血病是缺VC的结果，不是VC“治好”的病，根源是细胞饥饿。
跟客户别说“治好”“复发”，症状回来只是细胞又饿了，就像吃过晚饭第二天还会饿。
药店VC和食品级VC分子相同，差别在安全性和其他成分，天天吃就要选食品级。
keyEn: The body can't make vitamin C; scurvy is caused by lacking it, not "cured" by it. The root is hungry cells.
Don't tell clients a nutrient "cures" or symptoms "relapse"; symptoms return when cells go hungry again, like hunger the morning after dinner.
Pharmacy and food-grade vitamin C share one molecule; the difference is safety and other ingredients, so daily use calls for food grade.

lessons.title: VC抗氧化与提升免疫儿童排铅
lessons.titleEn: What Vitamin C Actually Does in the Body
key: VC增强白细胞吞噬细菌的能力并促进抗体生成，是免疫系统的“后勤补给队”。
胶原蛋白合成离不开VC，骨骼、牙龈、皮肤弹性和伤口愈合都靠它，它还帮助铁和钙吸收。
孩子铅超标早期表现像缺铁，补铁加VC既促吸收又帮排铅；成人VC可耐受上限2000毫克。
keyEn: Vitamin C boosts white blood cells' ability to engulf bacteria and promotes antibodies, acting as the immune system's supply team.
Collagen can't form without vitamin C, so bones, gums, skin and wound healing depend on it; it also aids iron and calcium absorption.
Early lead overload in children looks like iron deficiency; give iron plus vitamin C. The adult upper limit for vitamin C is 2,000 mg.

lessons.title: 维生素E抗氧化与细胞健康
lessons.titleEn: Vitamin E: Protecting Every Cell Membrane
key: VE是脂溶性抗氧化剂，给细胞膜穿“防护服”；红细胞膜被氧化易黏连，就是血黏度高。
VE三大作用：保护细胞膜，双向调节内分泌，慢慢清除纤维化、结节、囊肿和积液。
孕期VE不足，新生儿红细胞易破裂引发黄疸；纽崔莱VE是纯小麦胚芽油，每粒含18毫克。
keyEn: Vitamin E is the fat-soluble antioxidant guarding cell membranes; oxidized red cell membranes clump, which shows up as high blood viscosity.
Its three jobs: protect membranes, balance hormones in both directions, and slowly clear fibrosis, nodules, cysts and fluid buildup.
Low vitamin E in pregnancy lets newborn red cells rupture, causing jaundice. Nutrilite's E is pure wheat germ oil, 18 mg per capsule.

dated.zh: 课中小麦胚芽油每公斤1600到2000美元是录课时的行情，VE保护细胞膜的核心讲法不变。
dated.en: The wheat germ oil price of US$1,600 to 2,000 per kg reflects the time of recording; the core teaching on vitamin E still stands.

lessons.title: 维生素E抗氧化与新生儿黄疸
lessons.titleEn: Vitamin E, Aging and the Tissues That Harden
key: 新生儿重度黄疸会导致贫血并加重肝脏负担；早产儿进保温箱吸高浓度氧，妈妈要足量补VE护眼。
老花眼、腰容易扭伤、颈肩僵硬、手上长老年斑，都是缺VE导致肌肉萎缩和组织硬化的信号。
VE可耐受量每天400毫克，教科书给到700毫克，小麦胚芽油每天约20粒属于安全范围。
keyEn: Severe newborn jaundice brings anemia and liver overload; for incubator babies breathing high oxygen, the mother should take ample vitamin E.
Presbyopia, easy back strains, stiff neck and shoulders, and age spots signal low vitamin E, with muscle wasting and tissue hardening.
Vitamin E tolerable intake is 400 mg a day (textbooks say 700 mg); about 20 wheat germ oil capsules daily is safe.

lessons.title: 维生素A抗氧化与视力健康
lessons.titleEn: Carotenoids and Vitamin A: The Eyes and the Linings
key: 叶黄素保护视网膜黄斑区，黄斑变性一旦发生很难逆转，只能靠长期补叶黄素预防。
看手机电脑消耗的VA是看书的数倍，现代人靠吃胡萝卜根本补不够。
缺VA黏膜会角质化，鼻咽反复发炎、头皮屑多，胃幽门处角质化还容易长幽门螺杆菌。
keyEn: Lutein protects the macula; macular degeneration is very hard to reverse once it starts, so prevention means taking lutein consistently.
Phones and computers burn several times more vitamin A than reading; nobody can eat enough carrots to keep up.
Low vitamin A keratinizes linings: recurring nose and throat infections, heavy dandruff, and H. pylori growth near the stomach outlet.

lessons.title: 维生素A与生殖系统
lessons.titleEn: Vitamin A and the Reproductive System
key: 缺VA会让生殖道上皮角质化，女性白带增多有异味，男性前列腺钙化、精子数下降。
输卵管内壁角质化易致宫外孕和堵塞；缺VA时胎盘难形成，孕两三个月容易流产。
少女月经不调先想到缺VA，盲目用黄体酮会让卵巢停工萎缩，导致卵巢早衰。
keyEn: Low vitamin A keratinizes reproductive linings: heavy, odorous discharge in women; prostate calcification and falling sperm counts in men.
A keratinized fallopian tube invites ectopic pregnancy and blockage; without vitamin A the placenta forms poorly, risking miscarriage at two to three months.
For a teen's irregular periods, think vitamin A first; progesterone used without understanding lets the ovaries idle and shrink, leading to premature ovarian failure.

lessons.title: 维生素A抗氧化与儿童生长发育及器官病变
lessons.titleEn: Vitamin A, Immunity, Growth and Inflammation
key: 抗体是糖蛋白，VA参与合成，所以免疫力低时首先要想到补VA。
孩子九岁前偏矮别急着打生长激素，先补VA和蛋白质把内脏养好，青春期身高自然追上。
缺VA黏膜不能自洁，死细胞堆积形成结节、积液和囊肿；宝宝喝奶易呛也是缺VA的信号。
keyEn: Antibodies are glycoproteins that vitamin A helps build, so low immunity should make you think of vitamin A first.
If a child under nine is short, skip growth hormone; give vitamin A and protein to build the organs, and height catches up at puberty.
Without vitamin A, linings stop cleaning themselves; dead cells pile into nodules, fluid buildup and cysts. A baby choking on milk is another sign.

lessons.title: 维生素A如何安全摄取
lessons.titleEn: How Vitamin A Works in the Eye, and How to Take It Safely
key: 视网膜每秒要上百次分解重建感光物质，原料就是VA，合成跟不上就看不清，严重时夜盲。
直接补VA过量易中毒，β-胡萝卜素按需转化最安全；吃到皮肤发黄无害，停一阵再吃。
成人VA推荐男800、女700微克，上限3000微克；胡萝卜素女性每天2到4粒，男性最多6粒。
keyEn: The retina breaks down and rebuilds its light-sensitive pigment about 100 times a second from vitamin A; too little means blur and night blindness.
Preformed vitamin A can build to toxic levels; beta-carotene converts only as needed, so it's safest. Yellowish skin is harmless, just pause.
Adult vitamin A: 800 mcg for men, 700 mcg for women, upper limit 3,000 mcg. Beta-carotene: women 2 to 4 capsules, men up to 6.

dated.zh: 开头提到吴孟达病逝和延迟退休的新闻是2021年的时事，VA的核心讲法不变。
dated.en: The opening news items, Ng Man-tat's death and China's delayed-retirement debate, date from 2021; the vitamin A teaching still stands.

lessons.title: 身体“有矿”
lessons.titleEn: An Overview of Minerals
key: 矿物质身体不能合成，每天随汗尿便流失；生理量和中毒量很接近，钙磷比例不对还会互相拮抗。
孩子上午十一点就走神，常与缺铁、血红蛋白带氧不足有关；铁推荐男12、女20毫克，上限40毫克。
反渗透纯净水不含矿物质，长期直接喝会影响渗透压，只适合煮饭泡茶。
keyEn: The body can't make minerals and loses them daily; safe and toxic doses sit close, and wrong ratios like calcium to phosphorus block absorption.
A child losing focus by late morning may lack iron for oxygen transport; iron intake is 12 mg men, 20 mg women, upper limit 40.
Reverse osmosis water has no minerals, and drinking it straight long term affects osmotic pressure; use it for rice and tea.

lessons.title: 补钙无需过量
lessons.titleEn: How Much Calcium We Need, and Why Balance Matters
key: 国人膳食钙每天仅约389毫克，成人需800到1200毫克；钙镁片每片200多毫克，至少5到6片。
维生素短期可超上限当调理量，矿物质超过上限几乎不吸收，反而增加身体负担。
钙镁2比1吸收最好，钙还需要VC帮助吸收；镁和B族不足易出现抽搐、癫痫、哮喘等症状。
keyEn: Diets supply about 389 mg calcium daily versus 800 to 1,200 needed; at roughly 200 mg per Cal Mag tablet, take 5 to 6.
Vitamins can briefly exceed the upper limit as a conditioning dose; minerals above it are barely absorbed and only add burden.
A 2:1 calcium to magnesium ratio absorbs best, and calcium needs vitamin C; low magnesium and B vitamins show as spasms, seizures and asthma.

lessons.title: 分清骨质疏松和骨质增生（一）
lessons.titleEn: How to Choose Calcium, and Osteoporosis Versus Bone Spurs
key: 碳酸钙含钙量最高，达40%；要分次、饭后吃，一次吃太多会让胃酸瞬间升高。
补钙要看吸收率和利用率，还要镁、锌、铜、锰协同，就像砌墙除了砖还要水泥和钢筋。
补钙后骨痛消失是骨质疏松，缓解不明显多是骨质增生；骨刺说明钙在大量流失，不是钙多。
keyEn: Calcium carbonate is the richest form at 40 percent calcium; take it in divided doses after meals, since one big dose spikes stomach acid.
Strong bones need absorption and use, plus magnesium, zinc, copper and manganese, the way a wall needs cement and steel, not just bricks.
Pain that stops with calcium is osteoporosis; pain that lingers is usually bone spurs, which signal heavy calcium loss, not excess.

lessons.title: 给孩子存本儿“钙”
lessons.titleEn: Calcium Every Day, in Full: Protecting Your Bone Bank
key: 补钙原则是“天天足量”，差一点身体也会从骨头里多取，多取出的钙乱沉积就成了骨刺。
骨钙存款18到20岁存得最快，35岁达到骨峰值后只出不进，35岁前更要补钙存骨量。
孩子钙量不能按体型折算，1到3岁已需成人的四分之三，4到10岁与成人相当。
keyEn: The rule is "every day, in full": a small shortfall makes the body withdraw extra from bone, and the excess deposits as spurs.
Bone calcium deposits peak at 18 to 20 and stop around 35, so build peak bone mass before 35 and protect it after.
Never scale a child's calcium by size: ages 1 to 3 need three quarters of an adult's, ages 4 to 10 about equal.

lessons.title: 膳食纤维不可替代
lessons.titleEn: Dietary Fiber: The Overlooked Nutrient
key: 膳食纤维三大作用：调节糖脂吸收，清洁肠道促排便，被益生菌发酵成短链脂肪酸滋养结肠。
每餐先吃蔬菜水果再吃主食，既有饱腹感，又能少摄入脂肪和碳水。
东亚人肠道比白人长，食物残渣停留久易生毒素，更需要足够纤维加快排空。
keyEn: Fiber's three jobs: slow sugar and fat absorption, sweep the gut and ease constipation, and feed bacteria that make short-chain fatty acids.
Eat vegetables and fruit before the starch at each meal for fullness with less fat and carbohydrate.
East Asians have longer intestines than Westerners, so residue sits longer and breeds toxins; enough fiber moves it through faster.

lessons.title: 净肠瘦身美颜的益生菌
lessons.titleEn: Probiotics: Our Resident Bacteria and What They Do
key: 菌群最早来自顺产产道和母乳，剖腹产又没吃母乳的孩子菌群单薄。
腹泻首选益生菌，一次2到5条见效快；老人长期稀便，加大每日用量几天就好转。
胖瘦由菌群决定，益生菌还能促进自身生长激素分泌，帮孩子长个、帮成人修复器官。
keyEn: Babies get their first bacteria from vaginal birth and breast milk; a C-section baby who isn't breastfed starts with thin flora.
For diarrhea, probiotics come first: 2 to 5 sachets at once work fast, and a larger daily amount cleared an elder's months of loose stools.
Flora decides weight gain, and probiotics stimulate the body's own growth hormone, helping children grow and adults repair organs.

lessons.title: 益生菌与免疫生长发育
lessons.titleEn: Probiotics, Immunity, and the Gut-Brain Connection
key: 70%的免疫力驻扎在大肠，益生菌压住坏菌后，免疫兵力就能调往全身。
要快速见效就得一次大量，流感后咳嗽一次10条，比一次1条有效得多。
90%的血清素在肠道产生；复合益生菌偏肠道，儿童款偏过敏免疫，女士款偏情绪和妇科。
keyEn: About 70 percent of immunity sits in the large intestine; once probiotics suppress bad bacteria, those immune troops redeploy across the body.
For fast results take a lot at once: 10 sachets for a post-flu cough beats one sachet at a time.
90 percent of serotonin is made in the gut. Multi-strain leans gut, children's leans allergy and immunity, women's leans mood and gynecology.

dated.zh: 课中女士益生菌每人每月限购两盒等是录课时的供货政策，用法和作用的讲法不变。
dated.en: The two-boxes-a-month purchase limit reflects supply rules at the time of recording; the teaching on use and effects still stands.

lessons.title: 肠道微生态的建设者-益生菌
lessons.titleEn: The Gut Microbiome: Our Bacteria and Us
key: 妈妈和老人是重点补菌人群：妈妈的菌群直接传给孩子，老人身上的“老人味”是有益菌减少的信号。
70%免疫细胞在大肠，经常拉肚子说明免疫力不够，益生菌是提升免疫最快的方式。
有益菌主要是双歧杆菌和乳酸杆菌，能合成维生素、促进肠蠕动、抑制病菌、分解有毒物质。
keyEn: Mothers and the elderly need probiotics most: a mother's flora passes to her baby, and "old person smell" signals dwindling good bacteria.
With 70 percent of immune cells in the gut, frequent loose stools mean low immunity; probiotics are the fastest way to raise it.
The main good bacteria, Bifidobacterium and Lactobacillus, make vitamins, move the gut, suppress pathogens and break down toxins.

lessons.title: 益生菌家族之嗜酸乳杆菌鼠李糖乳杆菌干酪乳杆菌
lessons.titleEn: Three Key Lactobacillus Strains
key: 嗜酸乳杆菌分布在胃到大肠全程，分泌抑菌物质并帮双歧杆菌繁殖，纽崔莱三款益生菌都含有它。
鼠李糖乳杆菌耐胃酸和胆汁，紧贴肠壁形成屏障，可预防和改善腹泻，女士益生菌含有此菌。
干酪乳杆菌与嗜酸乳杆菌、双歧杆菌并称“健康三益菌”，能活着到达肠道，被认为有助降压降胆固醇。
keyEn: L. acidophilus lives from stomach to colon, secretes antibacterial substances and helps bifidobacteria multiply; all three Nutrilite probiotics contain it.
L. rhamnosus survives stomach acid and bile, clings to the gut wall as a barrier, and helps prevent diarrhea; it's in the women's probiotic.
L. casei, with acidophilus and bifidobacteria, forms the "three beneficial bacteria"; it reaches the gut alive and is credited with lowering blood pressure and cholesterol.

dated.zh: 课中用接种新冠疫苗解释特异性免疫，属于2021年前后的背景，菌株作用的讲法不变。
dated.en: The COVID vaccine example of adaptive immunity reflects the 2021 context; the teaching on these strains still stands.

lessons.title: 益生菌家族
lessons.titleEn: The probiotic family

lessons.title: 益生菌家族之双歧杆菌的10大作用
lessons.titleEn: Bifidobacterium: The Gut's Essential Resident
key: 双歧杆菌产生乙酸和乳酸，降低肠道pH，压制腐败菌；屁和大便特别臭，说明坏菌多。
双歧杆菌能合成B1、B2、B6和维生素K，并营造弱酸环境，帮助钙、铁、维生素D吸收。
腐败菌毒素经门静脉加重肝脏负担而影响睡眠，老人和压力大的人睡不好，补钙同时补益生菌。
keyEn: Bifidobacteria make acetic and lactic acid that lower gut pH and suppress putrefying bacteria; very foul gas or stool means bad bacteria dominate.
They synthesize B1, B2, B6 and vitamin K, and keep the gut mildly acidic so calcium, iron and vitamin D absorb well.
Toxins from bad bacteria burden the liver and disturb sleep; for poor sleep in elders or stressed adults, add probiotics alongside calcium.

lessons.title: 益生菌怎么选？怎么吃？

note.en: This lesson was transcribed by computer from the recording and has more mistakes than the others. Some terms are misheard and the figures in the clinical-trial section are unreliable. Check them against the recording before quoting.
note.zh: 本课由电脑根据录音自动转写，错字比其他课更多，临床试验部分的数字不可靠。引用前请对照录音核实。

key: 选益生菌看三个字：活、量、效；菌株要耐胃酸耐胆汁，关键是活着到达肠道的数量，不是标称数量。
好产品要配低聚果糖、菊粉等益生元，只供细菌吃、人不吸收，保证菌活着到达大肠。
用37℃以下的水或饮料冲，空腹也可以吃；少数人对菊粉不耐受会腹泻，就改成随餐吃。
keyEn: Judge a probiotic by three things: alive, amount, effect. Strains must survive acid and bile; what reaches the gut alive matters, not the label count.
Good products add prebiotics such as fructo-oligosaccharides and inulin, food only bacteria can use, so they survive the trip to the colon.
Mix with water or drinks below 37°C; an empty stomach is fine. If inulin causes loose stools, take it with meals instead.

lessons.title: 卵磷脂-细胞健康的基础
lessons.titleEn: Lecithin: A Foundation Nutrient for Every Cell
key: 细胞膜主要由卵磷脂构成，它像洗洁精一样把脂肪溶进水里带走，是人人需要的基础营养素。
卵磷脂是把脂肪运出肝脏的专用“运输车”，缺了易得脂肪肝，它还能帮胆汁里的胆固醇溶解。
卵磷脂是神经“绝缘层”和神经递质的原料，孕中后期到上学前需求最大；它怕氧化，要配VE。
keyEn: Cell membranes are built mainly of lecithin; like dish soap, it dissolves fat into water and carries it away, so everyone needs it.
Lecithin is the dedicated vehicle that ships fat out of the liver; without it fatty liver develops, and it keeps bile cholesterol dissolved.
It builds nerve insulation and signaling chemicals, most needed from late pregnancy to school age; it oxidizes easily, so pair it with vitamin E.

lessons.title: 血管的清道夫-卵磷脂
lessons.titleEn: Lecithin and Young Blood Vessels
key: 胆固醇偏高多因缺B族分解不了，不是吃多了；2016年后中美都取消了每日300毫克的限制。
日常每天800到1000毫克，即每粒390毫克的3到5粒；它没有可耐受上限，解决问题时短期加量。
卵磷脂先供应重要器官再到全身，量不够见不到效；重度脂肪肝案例每天45粒，三个月后消失。
keyEn: High cholesterol often reflects too few B vitamins to break it down, not overeating; the US and China dropped the 300 mg cap in 2016.
Daily needs are 800 to 1,000 mg, so 3 to 5 capsules at 390 mg; with no upper limit, problems call for much more short-term.
Lecithin serves vital organs first, so small doses show little; one severe fatty liver cleared in three months on 45 capsules a day.

lessons.title: GABA-大脑年轻态
lessons.titleEn: GABA and a Younger Brain
key: GABA是大脑的镇静性神经递质，随年龄增长而减少，缺了易焦虑、烦躁、疲劳、睡不好。
倍益舒不是安眠药，它激活脑细胞、延长深睡；刚吃反而更精神的人，可以加量度过激活期。
年轻态三件套睡前吃：卵磷脂3到5粒、倍益舒2到5片、益生菌2到5条，按预算定量。
keyEn: GABA is the brain's calming neurotransmitter and declines with age; low levels bring anxiety, irritability, fatigue and poor sleep.
Beiyishu is not a sleeping pill: it activates brain cells and lengthens deep sleep; if it makes you alert at first, increase the amount.
The youthfulness trio at bedtime: lecithin 3 to 5 capsules, Beiyishu 2 to 5 tablets, probiotics 2 to 5 sachets, sized to budget.

lessons.title: GABA倍益舒-舒心舒压舒眠
lessons.titleEn: Easing Stress: GABA and Sour Jujube Seed
key: GABA的核心作用是缓解压力：增加放松的α波，压制焦虑的β波，从而提高睡眠质量。
酸枣仁的有效成分是酸枣仁皂苷A和B，能提高GABA受体表达，促进身体自己分泌褪黑素。
课中试验显示，补GABA后更年期失眠或抑郁改善65%，更年期综合征改善75%。
keyEn: GABA's core job is easing stress: it raises relaxed alpha waves and suppresses anxious beta waves, which improves sleep quality.
Sour jujube seed works through jujubosides A and B, which raise GABA receptor expression and boost the body's own melatonin.
For menopause, the cited trial found GABA improved 65 percent of insomnia or depression cases and 75 percent of menopausal syndrome.

lessons.title: 健康启航 开启健康管理新篇章
lessons.speaker: 刘建军
lessons.titleEn: The Root Logic of Disease and the Path Back to Health
key: 所有慢病只有两个根源：毒素超标加细胞隐性饥饿，细胞功能先坏，器官才出症状。
无症状阶段是自我管理的最佳窗口，体检正常但失眠、长痘、肥胖都是身体信号。
解决之道是清调补养：清肠毒血毒，调生活方式和五脏，补细胞营养，顺四季和子午流注来养。
keyEn: Every chronic disease traces to two roots: toxin overload and cellular hidden hunger. Cells fail first, then organs, then symptoms appear.
The symptom-free stage is the best window to act. A normal checkup with poor sleep, acne or weight gain is still a signal.
The path is clear, regulate, replenish, nourish: clear gut and blood toxins, regulate lifestyle and organs, feed cells, follow seasons and daily rhythm.

lessons.title: 飞驰人生 从掌握健康仪表盘开始
lessons.speaker: 刘锦
lessons.titleEn: Your Personal Health Record Is Your Dashboard
key: 个人健康档案就是身体的仪表盘，由三份资料组成：体检报告、98项健康评估表、人体成分分析报告。
体检一年一次看底子，98项表读身体求救信号，人体成分可以天天测，相当于自己把脉。
开场可以问客户：谁是给你翻身的人？没病没痛就是千万富翁，别捡了芝麻丢了西瓜。
keyEn: A personal health record is the body's dashboard: three documents, the physical exam, the 98-item health assessment and the body composition report.
The exam shows your baseline yearly, the 98-item form reads distress signals, and body composition can be checked daily like taking your own pulse.
Opening questions for clients: who would turn you over in bed? Being free of illness makes you a multimillionaire, so don't trade health for money.

dated.zh: 课中的器官移植费用引自录制时美国某机构的图表，价格会变，但健康无价的道理不变。
dated.en: The organ transplant costs come from a US chart at the time of recording and will have changed; the point that health is priceless still stands.

lessons.title: 健康之路 从建立个人档案开始
lessons.titleEn: Start With a Personal Health Record

lessons.title: 健康密码 读懂体检报告
lessons.speaker: 李玲
lessons.titleEn: Reading Your Physical Exam Report as a Health Manager
key: 看体检要盯住血糖受损阶段，空腹血糖受损或糖耐量异常不干预，两年就可能走到糖尿病。
医生负责控制症状，我们负责修复细胞；血糖、血压、血脂、尿酸都是同一个逻辑。
感染、自身免疫指标、结节增生看似不同，健康管理都回到排毒、消炎、全营养修复细胞。
keyEn: On exam reports, watch the prediabetic stage. Impaired fasting glucose or glucose tolerance left alone for two years can become diabetes.
Doctors control symptoms; our job is repairing cells. Blood sugar, blood pressure, lipids and uric acid all follow the same logic.
Infection, autoimmune markers, nodules and cysts look different, but the health-management answer is the same: detox, calm inflammation, fully nourish cells.

dated.zh: 课中“疫情以来肺结节检出率很高”属疫情时期背景，用健康管理思维读体检报告的方法依然适用。
dated.en: The remark that lung nodule detection rose since the pandemic is COVID-era context; reading exam reports with health-management thinking still applies.

lessons.title: 读懂身体的求救信号
lessons.speaker: 李玲
lessons.titleEn: Reading Your Body's Distress Signals
key: 98项评估表：经常出现打勾，偶尔出现画圈，涵盖基本信息、11项不良习惯和各系统信号。
失眠多梦、情绪低落、急躁、眼干眼涩都指向肝：肝不藏血、肝主情志、肝开窍于目。
痛经是子宫平滑肌细胞隐性饥饿的早期信号，不重视可能发展成子宫肌瘤或子宫腺肌症。
keyEn: On the 98-item form, tick signals that occur often and circle occasional ones. It covers basics, 11 poor habits and signals by body system.
Insomnia with vivid dreams, low mood, short temper and dry, sore eyes all point to the liver in this framework.
Period pain is an early sign of hidden hunger in uterine smooth muscle. Ignored, it can progress to fibroids or adenomyosis.

dated.zh: 课中“春季感冒、近期流感高发”是录制时的季节背景，按系统读懂身体信号的方法不变。
dated.en: The spring cold and flu remarks reflect the season of recording; the system-by-system way of reading body signals still applies.

lessons.title: 把握健康脉搏 读懂人体成分分析报告
lessons.speaker: 刘锦
lessons.titleEn: Reading Your Body Composition Report
key: 人体成分看三部分七指标：BMI、体脂率、腰臀比、内脏脂肪等级，基础代谢、骨骼肌，骨密度。
看不见的脂肪更危险：内脏脂肪等级控制在4到6，男性腰围不超85厘米，女性不超80厘米。
存钱不如存肌肉，增肌靠三分练七分吃；35岁前补钙是存款，35岁后是少取款。
keyEn: Read body composition as three parts, seven indicators: BMI, body fat, waist-to-hip, visceral fat level; basal metabolism, skeletal muscle; bone density.
Invisible fat is the dangerous fat. Keep visceral fat level at 4 to 6, waist under 85 cm for men, 80 cm for women.
Saving muscle beats saving money; muscle is three parts exercise, seven parts nutrition. Calcium before 35 is a deposit, after 35 a smaller withdrawal.

lessons.title: 万病始于肠
lessons.speaker: 凌敏
lessons.titleEn: Most Disease Begins in the Gut
key: 清肠毒是清调补养第一步：99%营养经肠吸收，80%毒素靠菌群处理，约70%免疫在肠道。
肠毒信号：腹胀便秘、口臭、痘痘湿疹、失眠疲劳、情绪波动；肠漏后毒素入血引发全身炎症。
用膳食纤维加益生菌改善菌群，菌群变了口味跟着变，等于关掉毒素入口的水龙头。
keyEn: Clearing gut toxins comes first: 99% of nutrients are absorbed in the gut, flora process 80% of toxins, and about 70% of immunity lives there.
Gut-toxin signs: bloating, constipation, bad breath, acne or eczema, poor sleep, fatigue, mood swings. Leaky gut lets toxins into the blood, causing inflammation.
Dietary fiber plus probiotics rebuild the flora. When flora change, cravings change too, which turns off the tap where toxins enter.

lessons.title: 血净百病消
lessons.speaker: 凌敏
lessons.titleEn: When the Blood Is Clean, Disease Recedes
key: 肠毒不及时清就会入血，血浊百病生、血净百病消，所以清肠的同时必须清血毒。
清血用卵磷脂乳化带走血管壁斑块、调节甘油三酯和胆固醇，汉方的陈皮、当归活血化瘀。
减肥反弹的不是体重是生活方式；想长久健康，必须长期坚持无伤害的生活方式。
keyEn: Gut toxins left uncleared enter the blood. Turbid blood breeds illness and clean blood dispels it, so clear blood toxins alongside the gut.
Lecithin emulsifies and carries away vessel-wall plaque and regulates triglycerides and cholesterol; the herbal formula's tangerine peel and danggui move the blood.
What rebounds after weight loss is the lifestyle, not the weight. Lasting health needs a harm-free lifestyle kept for the long term.

lessons.title: 践行健康生活方式 把握健康根基
lessons.speaker: 潘金珍
lessons.titleEn: Regulating Your Lifestyle, the Source of Health
key: 影响健康的因素：生活方式占60%，环境17%，遗传15%，医疗只占8%，所以慢病又叫生活方式病。
睡眠以90分钟为一个周期倒推：5点起床要睡4个周期再加30分钟入睡，10点半就得上床。
运动要适度并随年龄降强度：20到30岁中高强度，40到50岁中低强度，50岁后选太极、八段锦。
keyEn: Health is 60% lifestyle, 17% environment, 15% genetics and only 8% medical care, which is why chronic diseases are called lifestyle diseases.
Plan bedtime by 90-minute sleep cycles: to rise at 5, allow four cycles plus 30 minutes to fall asleep, so be in bed by 10:30.
Exercise moderately and lower intensity with age: moderate-high at 20 to 30, moderate-low at 40 to 50, tai chi, Baduanjin or brisk walking after 50.

dated.zh: 课中引用的2024年巴菲特股东大会和疫情期间的案例属录制时的背景，生活方式决定健康的核心观点不变。
dated.en: The 2024 Berkshire Hathaway meeting and the pandemic-era case reflect when it was recorded; the core point that lifestyle drives health still stands.

lessons.title: 抗炎语录 植物中的秘密
lessons.speaker: 莫军晔
lessons.titleEn: Inflammation and the Secrets Hidden in Plants
key: 炎症反应本身是身体在修复，有害的是诱因：病毒细菌、氧化、各种损伤和毒素。
血管里的脂肪一旦被氧化就会损伤内膜，免疫修复让内膜增厚，形成动脉硬化和斑块。
维生素矿物质是抗炎正规军，植物营养素是特种部队：抗癌、抗氧化、抗炎、调血脂、调血糖。
keyEn: Inflammation itself is the body repairing damage; the triggers are the harm: viruses, bacteria, oxidation, injury and toxins.
When fat in the blood vessels oxidizes it inflames the lining; immune repair thickens it, forming hardened arteries and plaque.
Vitamins, minerals and good fats are the regular army against inflammation; phytonutrients are special forces: anti-cancer, antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, lipid and sugar regulating.

lessons.title: 自然的力量 纽崔莱的健康守护之道
lessons.speaker: 刘建军
lessons.titleEn: Why Nutrilite: The Best of Nature and the Best of Science
key: 纽崔莱是功能性食品，相当于三餐之外多一道高密度营养的菜，用来解决细胞隐性饥饿。
四个参考量：平均需要量、推荐摄入量、适宜摄入量、可耐受最高摄入量，维C上限2000毫克。
只吃到推荐量只能抵消每天的消耗；想修复细胞，剂量要高于适宜摄入量、低于最高上限。
keyEn: Nutrilite is a functional food, like one extra high-density dish beside three meals, used to resolve the cells' hidden hunger.
Four reference values: average requirement, recommended intake, adequate intake, tolerable upper level. Vitamin C's upper level is 2,000 mg a day.
Taking only the recommended amount just covers daily use. Repair needs a dose above adequate intake and below the upper level.

dated.zh: 课中的2023版膳食参考摄入量、获奖年数和每月约1500元的花费都是录制时的信息，剂量分层的道理不变。
dated.en: The 2023 intake tables, award streaks and roughly 1,500 yuan monthly cost are as of recording; the logic of dose tiers still stands.

lessons.title: 揭秘生命之基 蛋白质的奥秘
lessons.speaker: 丁桂珍
lessons.titleEn: Protein, the Source of Life
key: 蛋白质占人体18%，去掉水分约占八成，头发、指甲、肌肉、消化酶、抗体都靠它做原料。
蛋白不足也会贫血，因为血红蛋白要蛋白质和铁结合；伤口难愈合、脚肿眼肿也和缺蛋白有关。
补多少因人因时而异，参考四个量；记住可耐受最高量不等于中毒量，更不等于致死量。
keyEn: Protein is 18% of the body, about 80% of it without water. Hair, nails, muscle, digestive enzymes and antibodies are all built from it.
Low protein causes anemia because hemoglobin needs protein bound to iron. Poor wound healing and puffy feet or eyes also link to low protein.
How much varies by person and day; use the four reference amounts. The upper level is not a toxic dose, let alone a lethal one.

dated.zh: 课中把疫情当作免疫力的例子，属疫情时期背景，蛋白质是免疫原料的核心观点不变。
dated.en: The pandemic is used as the immunity example, which is COVID-era framing; protein as the raw material of immunity still stands.

lessons.title: 遇见快乐源泉：维生素B族的魅力
lessons.speaker: 丁桂珍
lessons.titleEn: The B Vitamins, the Source of Good Spirits
key: B族是水溶性，24小时内排出，必须每天补足；七兄弟协同工作，纽崔莱B1、B2、B6各1.2毫克。
口腔溃疡、口角炎、唇纵纹、头油头屑、眼皮跳都是缺B族的信号，有黏膜的地方缺B就难修复。
熬夜、压力、煮粥放碱、反复淘米、爱吃精米白面，都会大量流失B族。
keyEn: B vitamins are water-soluble and cleared within 24 hours, so replenish daily. The seven work together; Nutrilite has 1.2 mg each of B1, B2, B6.
Mouth ulcers, cracked mouth corners, lip lines, oily scalp, dandruff and eyelid twitches all signal low B vitamins; mucosa can't repair without them.
Late nights, stress, baking soda in congee, over-rinsed rice and refined rice and flour all drain B vitamins.

dated.zh: 课中“高考刚结束”是录制时的季节背景，压力越大B族消耗越大的道理不变。
dated.en: The note that college entrance exams just ended reflects the season of recording; that stress burns through B vitamins still stands.

lessons.title: 守护抗衰密码神奇的抗氧化三剑客与矿物质
lessons.speaker: 丁桂珍
lessons.titleEn: The Antioxidant Trio and the Minerals That Guard Aging
key: 维C是水溶性抗氧化剂，每天都要补足：帮助铁吸收、排铅、抑制色斑、促进胶原合成。
维E是脂溶性抗氧化剂，作用在细胞膜：淡化已形成的色斑、修复内外疤痕、支持生育力。
补维A优先用类胡萝卜素，身体按需转化不易过量；35岁前钙银行可以存，之后只取不存。
keyEn: Vitamin C is the water-soluble antioxidant, needed daily: it aids iron absorption and lead excretion, prevents spots and supports collagen synthesis.
Vitamin E is the fat-soluble antioxidant working in cell membranes: it fades existing spots, repairs scars inside and out, and supports fertility.
Get vitamin A from carotenoids, which the body converts only as needed. The calcium bank takes deposits until 35, then only withdrawals.

dated.zh: 课中多处以疫情期间的经历举例，属疫情时期背景，抗氧化三剑客和矿物质的讲解不变。
dated.en: Several examples draw on the pandemic, which is COVID-era framing; the teaching on the antioxidant trio and minerals still stands.

lessons.title: 营养早餐 健康相伴每一天
lessons.speaker: 刘锦
lessons.titleEn: A Nourishing Breakfast for Health Every Day
key: 养的四字秘诀：养在营养、养在早餐；7到9点胃经当令吃早餐，5到7点喝温水助排便。
典型中式早餐两高四不足：碳水和脂肪过高，维生素、矿物质、不饱和脂肪酸、纤维、蛋白不足。
6+1营养早餐一顿完成清调补：益生菌纤维清肠，优质脂类清血，真果蔬消炎，蛋白多维补细胞。
keyEn: Nourishing rests on nutrition and on breakfast. Eat breakfast 7 to 9 am in the stomach-meridian window; warm water 5 to 7 aids elimination.
Typical Chinese breakfasts are 'two highs, four lows': too much carbohydrate and fat, too little vitamins, minerals, unsaturated fat, fiber and protein.
The 6+1 breakfast does clear, regulate, replenish in one meal: probiotics and fiber, quality fats, fruit-and-vegetable concentrate, protein plus multivitamins.

dated.zh: 课中“今年6月柳叶刀报告”等统计按录制当年引用，早餐营养结构的核心建议不变。
dated.en: Statistics such as 'a Lancet report this June' are tied to the year of recording; the core breakfast guidance still stands.

lessons.title: 夏季养心篇让心强大 你才强大
lessons.speaker: 李玲
lessons.titleEn: Summer Heart Care: A Strong Heart Makes You Strong
key: 夏季养心，正午11到13点心经当令，午睡10到20分钟就能给心脏补血养护。
养心两宝：辅酶Q10是心脏小马达，汉方保心饮品用当归、陈皮、沙棘，护血管内膜、减少斑块。
每天喝水2000到3000毫升；胸闷胸痛心慌要及时就医，舌边齿痕、蚁走感也要警惕。
keyEn: Summer is heart season. The heart meridian runs 11 am to 1 pm; a 10 to 20 minute nap then helps the heart recover.
Two heart helpers: CoQ10, the heart's little motor, and the herbal heart drink of danggui, tangerine peel and sea buckthorn for vessel lining and plaque.
Drink 2,000 to 3,000 ml daily. See a doctor for chest pain, tightness or palpitations; watch tooth-marked tongue edges and crawling numbness.

dated.zh: 本课以“正值盛夏”的季节框架讲养心，换季收听时养心的方法依然适用。
dated.en: The lesson is framed around high summer; its heart-care methods still apply in any season.

lessons.title: 将军指令：养肝之道 护卫全身
lessons.speaker: 莫军晔
lessons.titleEn: Caring for the Liver, the Body's General
key: 肝是将军之官：入睡难、脸色晦暗、指甲竖纹、无故崴脚抽筋都是肝藏血不足的信号。
10+5护肝计划：10粒B族加5粒养藏善衡片，晚上7:30到8:40心包经当令时一起吃。
肝细胞约半年更新，护肝至少180天；初期服后起小红点或发热刺麻，几分钟到二十分钟会消退。
keyEn: The liver is the body's general. Trouble falling asleep, dull complexion, ridged nails, sudden cramps or sprains signal insufficient liver blood.
The 10+5 liver plan: 10 B-complex tablets plus 5 Yangzang Shanheng tablets, taken together between 7:30 and 8:40 pm.
Liver cells renew about every six months, so commit to 180 days. Early red spots, warmth or tingling after a dose fade within minutes.

lessons.title: 守护先天之本 肾脏的养生智慧
lessons.speaker: 凌敏
lessons.titleEn: Guarding the Root of Life: Kidney Care
key: 肾是先天之本，养肾先养脾胃、护肝：早上营养早餐养脾胃，晚上7:30做10+5护肝，再护肾。
护肾搭配：男士银杏叶苁蓉片加汉方宝元饮品，女士银杏叶苁蓉片加活颜饮品。
失眠分型：入睡难先护肝，心肾不交养肝再养心养肾，深睡差加酸枣仁和GABA。
keyEn: The kidney is the root of life; care for spleen-stomach and liver first: nourishing breakfast mornings, the 10+5 liver plan at 7:30 pm.
Kidney care pairings: for men, Ginkgo and Cistanche tablets with the Hanfang Baoyuan drink; for women, the same tablets with the Huoyan drink.
Insomnia by type: trouble falling asleep, start with the liver; heart-kidney imbalance, liver then heart then kidney; shallow sleep, add Suanzaoren and GABA.

dated.zh: 课中“2020年中国睡眠指数报告3亿人有睡眠障碍”是特定年份数据，养肾和分型调睡眠的方法不变。
dated.en: The 2020 China Sleep Index figure of 300 million is year-specific data; the kidney care and sleep-by-type approach still stands.

lessons.title: 健康之路 清调补养
lessons.speaker: 刘建军
lessons.titleEn: The Logic of Disease and the Road to Health
key: 万病胃为先，治病先治肝：早上营养早餐养脾胃，晚上护肝计划养肝，当作一辈子的习惯。
血压高不等于高血压，血糖高不等于糖尿病；在动脉硬化或胰岛萎缩之前，根源都在肝的代谢。
分层做：体检异常做护肝加深度修复；亚健康每月7天调肠加植物营养素；无症状就早餐加护肝。
keyEn: For every illness the stomach comes first; to treat illness, treat the liver first. Breakfast for the stomach mornings, liver plan evenings, for life.
Elevated blood pressure is not yet hypertension, high sugar not yet diabetes, before atherosclerosis or pancreatic atrophy; the root is liver metabolism.
By stage: abnormal exam, liver plan plus deep repair; sub-health, 7 days of gut care monthly plus phytonutrients; no symptoms, breakfast plus liver plan.

series.title: 中西精粹专业护肝健康课

lessons.title: 为什么养肝刻不容缓
lessons.titleEn: Why Liver Care Cannot Wait
key: 人人都需要护肝：柴米油盐柴为首，柴属木，木养肝，现代生活少了木气，肝缺少扶持。
从“肝”字看身体：月代表肌肉，干代表躯干，躯干过瘦或脂肪过多都提示肝已受损。
月亮出来该睡觉，睡不着说明肝阴虚，夜里反复起夜，久了会发展成肝肾两虚。
keyEn: Everyone needs liver care. Firewood heads the list of daily essentials; it is wood, and wood nourishes the liver. Modern life has lost that wood.
Read the character 肝: 月 is flesh, 干 is trunk. Too little flesh or too much fat on the torso signals a damaged liver.
Night is for sleep. Not sleeping means liver yin deficiency; frequent night waking and urination can progress to combined liver-kidney deficiency.

dated.zh: 本系列以“春天护肝”开讲，带有季节框架，人人都需护肝的核心观点四季适用。
dated.en: The series opens framed as spring liver care; its core point that everyone needs liver care applies year-round.

lessons.title: 为什么治病从肝起
lessons.titleEn: Why Healing Starts With the Liver
key: 肾司二便，便秘光清肠一停就复发；肝脾相生、脾为后天之本，要先养肝再养脾，才养得回肾。
肝为魂之处、筋之宗：睡不好次日没魄力、易起床气；静脉曲张、痔疮、痛经都属筋的问题。
跟客户聊天不做专家做行家：少讲术语，把知识讲成常识，先自己极致体验再真诚分享。
keyEn: The kidney governs elimination, so gut cleansing alone lets constipation return. Liver feeds spleen, spleen feeds kidney: nourish liver first, then spleen.
The liver houses the hun and governs the sinews: poor sleep means no decisiveness and morning irritability; varicose veins, hemorrhoids, period pain are sinew issues.
With clients, be a practitioner, not an expert: skip jargon, turn knowledge into common sense, and share only what you have fully experienced.

dated.zh: 课中“立春了大家养肝”是录制时的季节背景，先肝后脾再肾的调养顺序四季适用。
dated.en: The 'spring has begun, start liver care' framing reflects the recording season; the liver, spleen, kidney order applies year-round.

lessons.title: 传统医学对肝的解读
lessons.titleEn: The Liver in Traditional Chinese Medicine
key: 嘴唇、牙龈、脸色发暗是肝藏不住血；男性多见发暗、铁偏高，女性多见嘴唇泛白、缺铁。
舌下两根青筋突出，提示心肝要同护：肝为心之母，还有肝肾同源、肝肺调畅、肝脾相生。
伤肝路线：健康肝、脂肪肝、肝纤维化、肝硬化；个案逆转只能当个案，绝不能对外宣传。
keyEn: Dark lips, gums or complexion mean the liver isn't storing blood. Men tend toward dark lips and excess iron, women toward pale lips, low iron.
Raised veins under the tongue call for caring for heart and liver together: the liver is the heart's mother, and links to kidney, lung, spleen.
The damage path runs healthy liver, fatty liver, fibrosis, cirrhosis. Reported reversals are individual cases and must never be promoted.

lessons.title: 护肝路线图
lessons.titleEn: A Roadmap for Liver Care
key: 最好的影响力是讲自己的感受；不许诺结果，个案逆转千万不要大范围宣传。
细胞更新周期：胃7天、皮肤黏膜28天、血液120天、肝细胞180天，骨细胞约7年。
护肝180天只是基础版；胃黏膜修复按120天坚持植物双肽蛋白，2勺约含40毫克透明质酸。
keyEn: The best influence is sharing how you feel. Never promise results, and never broadcast individual reversals.
Renewal cycles: stomach 7 days, skin and mucosa 28, blood 120, liver cells 180 (over 90% renewed), bone about 7 years.
Liver care's base version is 180 days. Stomach lining repair takes 120 days of plant dual-peptide protein; 2 scoops give about 40 mg hyaluronic acid.

lessons.title: 护肝相关知识（上）
lessons.titleEn: Liver Basics, Part 1
lessons.speaker: 营养健康公益学堂
key: 正常肝摸起来像嘴唇，脂肪肝或炎症像鼻尖，肝硬化晚期硬如额头；硬化不可逆，只能延缓。
中西精粹护肝：张仲景芍药甘草汤，白芍养血柔肝、甘草健脾，再加葡萄籽原花青素和萝卜硫苷。
伤肝因素：酒精、口服药、烧糊油炸的苯并芘、受潮粮食的黄曲霉毒素、干洗剂中的四氯化碳。
keyEn: Healthy liver feels soft like a lip, fatty or inflamed like a nose tip, late cirrhosis hard as a forehead. Cirrhosis can only be slowed.
East-West liver care: Zhang Zhongjing's peony-licorice formula, peony to nourish blood and soften the liver, licorice for the spleen, plus grape seed OPC and glucoraphanin.
Liver harms: alcohol, all oral drugs, benzopyrene from reheated charred or fried food, aflatoxin from damp-stored grain, carbon tetrachloride in dry-cleaning fluid.

lessons.title: 护肝相关知识（下）
lessons.titleEn: Liver Basics, Part 2
lessons.speaker: 营养健康公益学堂
key: 萝卜硫苷像垃圾转运车，帮肝把毒物运出体外，避免焚烧式解毒产生自由基二次伤害。
转氨酶像饺子馅：血里测出来说明肝细胞破了，越高损伤越重，升高时问题已不轻。
沿肝经看：两颧黄褐斑、两鬓前额早白、眼干涩迎风流泪、指甲横竖纹易断，都提示肝的问题。
keyEn: Glucoraphanin works like a garbage truck, hauling toxins out instead of 'burning' them, which would release free radicals and cause secondary damage.
Transaminases are like dumpling filling: found in the blood, liver cells have broken. Higher means more damage, and by then it is already serious.
Along the liver meridian: cheekbone melasma, early gray temples, dry eyes or tearing in wind, ridged brittle nails all point to the liver.
